common.tagline: Lock your natively staked SOL with a second key you control, so a stolen wallet key cannot withdraw it.
common.comingSoonBody: Coming soon: this page is not ready yet.
common.notFoundBody: There is no page at this address.
common.neverSeedPhrase: Stakeward never asks for your seed phrase.
common.cannotMoveSol: This transaction cannot move your SOL.

landing.title: Protect your staked SOL
landing.body: Stakeward puts a lock on your existing stake accounts. While the lock holds, the stake can only be withdrawn or moved to a new owner when your second key co-signs.
landing.cannotDo1: It cannot protect liquid staking tokens, stake held on exchanges or SOL in your wallet balance.
landing.cannotDo2: It cannot stop someone with your main key from deactivating or redelegating the stake; they still cannot take it.
landing.cannotDo3: Whoever holds the second key can freeze the stake by moving the lock date. Guard the second key as carefully as the main one.
landing.cannotDo4: It never holds your funds and never sees your keys or seed phrase.

status.protectedHint: Withdrawing or changing the owner needs your second key until {date}.
status.expiringHint: The lock ends on {date}. Extend it to stay protected.
status.unprotectedHint: Anyone with your main key can withdraw this stake.
status.lockedByOtherHint: The second key is {address}. Connect it if it is yours.
status.secondKeyNotConnectedHint: Connect your second key to manage this lock.
status.managedByService: A staking service may manage this stake.

errors.lockup-in-force: Locked until {date}: your second key must co-sign.
errors.lockup-in-force-no-date: This stake is locked: your second key must co-sign.
errors.custodian-missing: This change needs your second key too: it must co-sign before you send.
errors.custodian-signature-missing: Your second key is part of this transaction but did not sign. Ask it to sign, then send again.
errors.already-deactivated: This stake is already deactivated. Refresh to see its current state.
errors.too-soon-to-redelegate: This stake is still deactivating. Delegate it again after the current epoch ends.
errors.insufficient-delegation: This stake holds less than the 1 SOL minimum the network allows to delegate.
errors.merge-mismatch: These stake accounts cannot be combined: their keys or locks differ.
errors.missing-signature: A key that must sign did not, or it no longer controls this stake. Check the connected wallets and try again.
errors.insufficient-funds: There is not enough SOL for this. If the stake is still deactivating, wait until the epoch ends; if the wallet paying the fee is empty, add a little SOL to it. Then try again.
errors.blockhash-expired: This transaction expired before it reached the network. Sign it again.
errors.nonce-advanced: This signing link is no longer valid: it was used or cancelled. Start again to get a new one.
errors.already-processed: This transaction already went through. Refresh to see the current state.
errors.wallet-rejected: The request was declined in the wallet. Nothing was sent; you can try again.
errors.network: The Solana network did not respond. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Refresh to see the current state, then try again.
